Meet Life's a Treat

Made to order in Johnstown

Life's a Treat is a bakery at 159 Gilbert St in Johnstown, PA, run by owner Karen Oleksa. The listing describes the shop in its own words as 'Preordered baked goods!' The shop publishes seasonal order-form menus on its Facebook Page for Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas.

The range runs to custom cakes for special occasions, cookies by the dozen and in assorted trays, cupcakes, gobs, rolls (apricot, nut, poppyseed, pumpkin), 10-inch pies, hot cocoa bombs and hot tea bombs, and DIY cookie kits. The owner-claimed Yelp profile lists delivery and take-out.
